partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: GO-CAM input-flow GOF suppression
results.hypothesis: Suppressing a directly bound gene whose GO-CAM activity is an input to a GOF disease driver may reduce pathogenic molecular flow.
results.body: drug decreases bound upstream gene; GO-CAM says upstream is input to GOF driver
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule uses curated molecular-flow topology, but IS_INPUT_OF does not explicitly state monotonic activation.
results.trapi_notes: The binding, effect, GO-CAM flow, and variant-qualified disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; source, identity, and disease constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (upstream:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(upstream)
MATCH (upstream)-[flow:IS_INPUT_OF]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE upstream <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:go-cam' IN coalesce(flow.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.body: R354 with increased rather than decreased upstream activity
results.mechanism_rationale: The drug nominally increases molecular flow toward a GOF driver.
